info.title: Matomo Reporting API for UsersManager plugin

get.description: Get the list of all available roles.

200.description:
List of available roles.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Get the list of all available capabilities.

200.description:
List of available capabilities.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Sets a supported UsersManager preference for a user.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Login of the user whose preference should be updated.

parameters.name: preferenceName
parameters.description: Preference name registered by UsersManager or plugin configuration.

parameters.name: preferenceValue
parameters.description: Value to store for the preference.

get.description: Returns a supported UsersManager preference for a user.

parameters.name: preferenceName
parameters.description: Preference name registered by UsersManager or plugin configuration.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: User login to read. Use `false` to read the current user.

200.description:
Stored preference value, or the default value when none was saved yet.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns all users with their role for $idSite.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to inspect.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of users to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based result offset.

parameters.name: filter_search
parameters.description: Text to search for in user login or email.

parameters.name: filter_access
parameters.description: Access filter for the site. Accepted values are `noaccess`, `some`, `view`, `write`, `admin`, and `superuser`. Filtering by `superuser` is only allowed for super users.

parameters.name: filter_status
parameters.description: Invite status filter.

200.description:
Users visible to the current requester, enriched with role and capabilities for the site.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns users visible to the current requester.

parameters.name: userLogins
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of user logins to fetch. Leave empty to return every visible user.

200.description:
Matching users enriched with invite and access metadata.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the login names of all users visible to the current requester.

200.description:
Matching user logins.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the site IDs where each user has the requested access entry.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Access entry to match, for example a role or capability ID.

200.description:
Mapping of user login to site IDs where that access entry is assigned.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns one access entry per visible user for the requested site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Numeric site ID.

200.description:
Mapping of user login to access entry.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns users who have the requested access entry for a website.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to inspect.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Access entry to match, for example a role or capability ID.

200.description:
Matching users enriched with user metadata.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the raw site access entries assigned to a user.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Existing user login to inspect.

200.description:
Site access rows for the user.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns site access rows for a non-superuser, with filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Existing non-superuser login to inspect.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sites to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based result offset.

parameters.name: filter_search
parameters.description: Text to search in site names, URLs, or groups.

parameters.name: filter_access
parameters.description: Access filter. Accepted values are `some`, `view`, `write`, or `admin`.

200.description:
Site access rows including role and explicit capabilities for each returned site.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns one user's metadata as visible to the requester.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Existing user login to fetch.

200.description:
Enriched user data, or an empty array when no user record is returned.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns one user's metadata for the given email address.

parameters.name: userEmail
parameters.description: Existing email address to look up.

200.description:
Enriched user data, or an empty array when no user record is returned.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Creates a new user account.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Login name for the new user.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for the new user.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address for the new user.

parameters.name: _isPasswordHashed
parameters.description: `true` if `$password` is already pre-hashed for storage.

parameters.name: initialIdSite
parameters.description: Initial site to grant `view` access to. Required for non-superusers.

parameters.name: passwordConfirmation
parameters.description: Current user's password confirmation when required by session auth.

get.description: Invites a new user by email and grants initial access to a website.

get.description: Enable or disable Super user access to the given user login. Note: When granting Super User access all previous permissions of the user will be removed as the user gains access to everything.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: User login to update.

parameters.name: hasSuperUserAccess
parameters.description: `true` or `1` to grant super user access, `false` or `0` to remove it.

parameters.name: passwordConfirmation
parameters.description: Current user's password confirmation when required.

get.description: Detect whether the current user has super user access or not.

200.description:
`true` if the current user has super user access.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns all users that currently have super user access.

200.description:
Super user records enriched with invite metadata.

parameters.name: password

parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Current user's password confirmation when required by session auth.

get.description: Signs a user out of all active sessions. Requires super user access.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Login of the user to sign out.

parameters.name: passwordConfirmation
parameters.description: Current user's password confirmation when required by session auth.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Login to check.

200.description:
`true` if the login exists.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

`true` if the email exists.

get.description: Sets access entries for a user across one or more websites.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: User login to update.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Access entries to grant. Use `noaccess` to remove access, or provide one role plus optional capabilities.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to update. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"

parameters.name: passwordConfirmation
parameters.description: Current user's password confirmation. Only required through session auth when granting anonymous `view` access or the `admin` role.

get.description: Adds the given capabilities to the given user for the given sites.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: User login to update.

parameters.name: capabilities
parameters.description: Capability IDs to add.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID or IDs to update.

get.description: Removes the given capabilities from the given user for the given sites.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: User login to update.

parameters.name: capabilities
parameters.description: Capability IDs to remove.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID or IDs to update.

get.description: Generates a new app-specific API token for a user.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Login name or email address for the user.

parameters.name: passwordConfirmation
parameters.description: The user's current password.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description for the app-specific token, for example an app name.

schema.example: Compare the pricing page signup experience for New Zealand traffic.

parameters.name: expireDate
parameters.description: Optional expiry date for the token.

parameters.name: expireHours
parameters.description: Optional number of hours before the token expires. Ignored when `$expireDate` is set.

parameters.description: `true` if the token must not be accepted in GET requests.

200.description:
Newly generated app-specific token.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: UsersManager
tags.description: The UsersManager API lets you Manage Users and their permissions to access specific websites. You can create users via "addUser", update existing users via "updateUser" and delete users via "deleteUser". There are many ways to list users based on their login "getUser" and "getUsers", their email "getUserByEmail", or which users have permission (view or admin) to access the specified websites "getUsersWithSiteAccess". Existing Permissions are listed given a login via "getSitesAccessFromUser", or a website ID via "getUsersAccessFromSite", or you can list all users and websites for a given permission via "getUsersSitesFromAccess". Permissions are set and updated via the method "setUserAccess". See also the documentation about Managing Users in Matomo.
